$comment: Teams of this repository. Format: a JSON object whose 'teams' array holds one entry per team with 'id' (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, referenced by the 'team' of a scope in penguin/scopes.json), 'name', 'lead' (a person id from penguin/owners.json, usually the engineering manager, who need not be a member) and 'members' (the person ids of the team).
